purpose: Define reusable encounter archetype records across combat, social, investigation, exploration, travel, stealth, chase, survival, hazard, puzzle/problem, political, hybrid and boss/solo structures without creating an Encounter draft, live state, universal difficulty scalar or guaranteed outcome.
controlling_rule: A GCL-04 record describes a reusable encounter shape: what kinds of participants, objectives, pressures, transitions and alternative approaches may matter. It does not bind real participants, invent mechanics, declare difficulty, predict player behavior, create a Campaign-local Encounter, approve a snapshot, attach it to a Scene, or resolve the encounter.

nonauthorization: does not create, approve, analyze or attach a real Encounter
does not create Campaign-local placements, quantities, waves, visibility state or overrides
does not create a universal Challenge Rating, encounter level, threat score or cross-domain power scalar
does not certify balanced, fair, safe, winnable, optimal or guaranteed outcomes
does not invent participant abilities, hazard mechanics, objective mechanics, boss phases or source canon
does not mutate Scene launch state, Session state, combat state or Events
does not bypass permission, entitlement, pack, rules-profile, scale or compatibility checks

stable_id_rule: encounter_template_id must begin with the manifest-declared family prefix and remain stable across wording-only revisions; semantic breaking changes require a new template version or stable ID.
parameterization_rule: structure_pattern and setup_pattern may use only declared {slot_id} placeholders. Every placeholder must be present in slot_ids and every slot_id must exist in the controlled slot vocabulary.

slot_vocabulary.semantic_role: one or more governed participant/character/NPC/creature groups later bound by the consumer
opposing, competing or obstructing actor/group/reference; not presumed hostile unless owning context says so
governed location/zone/scene reference
person, object, place, state, process or goal at issue
person/group/object whose continued safety/access/function may matter
scarce, contested, carried, consumed or useful governed resource
device, mechanism, structure, vehicle or other governed technical object
path, corridor, itinerary, passage or movement option
later-arriving governed participant/support reference and trigger owned by the consumer
recognized decision maker, gatekeeper, office, institution or rule-enforcing actor
person/source able to provide partial information
third party, mediator, observer or stakeholder not automatically aligned
time window, countdown, deadline or temporal condition governed by the consumer
social bond, debt, obligation, trust or rivalry state supplied by owning context
clue, sign, testimony, trace, record or observable indicator
bounded occurrence, prior event or ongoing event reference
deliberately unresolved fact or force
governed environmental/system hazard reference
actor/group currently attempting to close, intercept or track
actor/group currently attempting to evade, outrun or reach a destination
barrier, constraint, access problem or problem element
organized interest/group/institution reference

pressure_reference_rule: pressure_dimensions identifies which PPIA-11/F012 dimensions the archetype structurally exposes for later assessment. It is descriptive metadata only: no magnitude, weighting, score, target band, easier/harder direction or guarantee is encoded in GCL-04.
objective_boundary: objective_prompts are open construction questions only. GCL-05 owns the mature reusable objective/stakes/outcome library; F012 owns actual Encounter objective bindings and approval.

difficulty_boundary.rule: GCL-04 can identify pressure dimensions inherent to a structure but may not recommend numeric or directional tuning. GCL-07 consumes GCL-04/05/06 plus PPIA-11/F012 to provide later uncertainty-aware pressure-shaping advice.

boss_solo_boundary.rule: boss_solo records describe focal-adversary encounter structure only. GCL-08 owns source-respecting adversary role/transformation kits. GCL-04 may not create powers, phases, resistances, actions, immunities, stat multipliers or canon weaknesses.

solution_openness.rule: Encounter archetypes expose possible aims, pressures, exits and approaches without prescribing a single solution or outcome.

discovery_rule: Intent-first discovery filters construction need, play emphasis, duration, prep depth, tone and encounter family before expert browsing.
composition_rule: GCL-04 can consume GCL-02 hooks and GCL-03 situations and later compose with GCL-05 objectives, GCL-06 complications, GCL-07 difficulty shaping, GCL-08 adversary roles, GCL-09 mysteries, GCL-10 adventures, GCL-13 NPC roles and F012 Encounter drafts. All composition remains proposal material until accepted by the owning domain.
